title: Blind stroke-sculpt skull run 4 with surface-curve strokes and one-pass sculpting
user-messages: and then after both are ready do a 4th blind run with the new tools
definition-of-done: dsl/skull4/ holds base.dsl, base.ply, the outlines SVG, one-pass skull.dsl with its SVG and .strokes sidecar, and loads; the judge stopped the run by the rule and its scores file records every round; the final sculpt is shown beside the references with an animation of the rounds; every friction hit is recorded on this ticket.
testing-plan: No code: the judge scores each round with mesh-compare chamfer/Hausdorff and a headlit clay image distance, all numbers recorded in the judge directory and, after the stop, in tmp/mesh-88-measurements.json.
changes-made: Run 4 stopped by the judge after round 5 (no-change streak: rounds 3-5). Base outline checkpoint 60.4 px against 70 after the MESH-80 upside-down read fix (the flipped base scored 101). Best chamfer 0.01649 at round 2 (base 0.02004, floor 0.00216; best of any run: run 3 0.01804, run 2 0.01986, MESH-68 with the goal visible 0.0170). Image distance (headlight on) never beat the base 0.2677, rising to 0.32; Hausdorff fell 0.146 to 0.107. Mid-run, sculpt-sync bugs found in round 1 were fixed in MESH-86 and round 1 re-scored (0.016728). Final sculpt dsl/skull4/skull.dsl (base.ply + one stroke_sculpt, 43 strokes in 8 groups); per-round numbers in tmp/mesh-88-measurements.json; sculptor notes tmp/rounds.md, tmp/frictions.md, side-by-side tmp/final_vs_references.png. Limits: eye sockets capped near 0.22 deep by surface folding (MESH-78), no holes through the surface, teeth as even blocks; open tool problems ticketed separately.
